description.value: Kaide Sushi Bar is a Japanese restaurant on Richards Street in downtown Vancouver, operating for over 20 years. The kitchen sources fresh local ingredients and prepares all fish in-house, positioning it as a quality sit-down sushi destination. Its central Vancouver location could make it a convenient meal stop for urban cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 55m; stands (8 spaces) at 56m; bollard (2 spaces) at 71m; bollard (2 spaces) at 71m; wave (4 spaces) at 72m; bollard (2 spaces) at 73m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 82m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms address (1375 Richards Street, Vancouver BC V6Z 2X6) and phone (604.681.5886) matching OSM values; the site is live and the business appears open. The website content is minimal — it establishes a 20-year-old Japanese restaurant emphasising fresh local ingredients and in-house fish preparation — but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-relevant amenities, leaving all required criteria and most optional amenities as null. A notable hours discrepancy exists between OSM and the website, flagged as a concern.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM records Tu-Th 11:30-21:00, Fr 11:30-22:00, Sa 17:00-22:00; website lists Tue-Fri 12:00pm-8:00pm, Sat 4:00pm-8:00pm — the two sources differ substantially and it is unclear which is current.
Website copyright footer references domain 'kaidesushi.com' while the active URL is 'vancouverkaidesushi.com' — possible legacy domain reference or redirect situation worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed by the website or OSM tags. A human reviewer should visit or contact the business to establish whether minimum WWC criteria are met before listing.
